lines.en: why are you, soldier, so deep in thought?
Is it the pack, soldier, that is heavy,
or is it the rifle, soldier, that is heavy?
- Neither the pack, my dear, is heavy
nor the rifle, my dear, is heavy.
Last night I passed by our gate,
my mother was walking through the yard,
walking through the yard, shedding tears,
